::: {.notes}
**Table.** The source groups these three rows under Science and math. The percentages retain each benchmark’s own grading. Google uses its highest thinking setting unless otherwise specified. For Terminal-Bench Science, Google computed Argon with an extended verifier timeout and quotes the public leaderboard for Astra. Google computed both LABBench 2 results with tools and internet access. RiemannBench comes from Surge’s leaderboard. [Evaluation methodology](https://deepmind.google/models/evals-methodology/gemini-4-argon). [Google DeepMind · Model Card, Evaluation results](https://deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-4-argon/).

**Figure.** Google DeepMind, “Evaluation results”, Long context / GraphWalks, BFS (F1), Gemini 4 Argon. The annotation subtracts 84.2 from 99.7. The groups represent different problem lengths, not a controlled ablation on identical examples. [Primary source](https://deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-4-argon/).

Argon is a closed-weight model with unusually broad category-level disclosure, so a datasheet fits despite closed access. The model card identifies a sparse MoE Transformer and native text, vision and audio inputs, but gives no parameter, expert or layer count. The full data list also includes public datasets, internal/workforce data, synthetic examples and video. The public stack includes TPUs, TPU Pods, JAX and ML Pathways.

The 1,048,576-token window is shared by input, thinking and output. A streaming call is limited to 64K output and a non-streaming call to 32K, with a 20-minute request limit. Long decode continues in chunks of up to 64K and can approach the window minus the input; SDK continuation or background execution is required. Thinking consumes max_output_tokens. Function calling requires preserving thought signatures. Computer use is preview, and the model outputs text only. Explicit caching is unsupported, while implicit caching starts at 4,096 tokens. The workbook lists promotional $2/$10 pricing through 30 November 2026 and double pricing from December; this dated schedule is intentionally not a permanent headline.

Audit limits matter: the workbook did not directly open the full safety report. Rows 30–31 and the code execution, grounding and structured-output details in rows 53–55 were not rechecked, so they are not presented as independently confirmed capabilities here.

**Snapshot and provenance.** LLM_v1.0.xlsx, sheet “Gemini 4 Argon”, audit dated 18.10.2026. Category statuses follow “Сводка”: Architecture: Known; Data: Known; Training: Known; Inference: Known; Tools: Known. Known means a model-specific fact is disclosed, not that the whole category is complete. These slides summarize the supplied audit and do not constitute a fresh independent verification. Prices, limits and availability refer to that snapshot.
